items.difficulty_reason: 5 行、投射模加自由模补成自由模：投射性给出 F_0 = P ⊕ Q 自由；取 F = ⊕_{n≥1} F_0；Eilenberg swindle 引理给出 P ⊕ F ≅ F，故 P ⊕ F 自由。承重两步（投射性拆分、swindle 同构）都在 span 内；1 处引用作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-projective-plus-free-is-free (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 38995-38999

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: split off the projective module from a free module, add countably many copies of that free module as F, and use the Eilenberg swindle to identify P plus F with F (source lines 39001-39006)
